<TextView android:id="@+id/tvMulta" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:tag="tvMulta" android:textColor="@color/sgb_indisponivel" android:visibility="gone" />

</LinearLayout>
</androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
